shared_validation.family_definition: Exact Dhatupatha citation including markers, plus gana; not an etymological lemma split.
shared_validation.scope: Full regeneration, semantic fields, all accepted gold variants, prompt identity, split membership and declared sampling exclusions.
shared_validation.limits: Does not independently certify Sanskrit correctness, empirical difficulty, contamination absence or benchmark sampling precision.

novelty.normalization: Citation+class+four coordinates, ignoring code/gloss; only no-prefix/no-added-operation/no-specified-pada inputs.
